READ	SELECT count(*) AS Three FROM TIMESTAMP_TBL WHERE d1 = timestamp 'tomorrow'
READ	SELECT count(*) AS One FROM TIMESTAMP_TBL WHERE d1 = timestamp 'yesterday'

READ	SELECT '' AS `63`, d1 FROM TIMESTAMP_TBL

READ	SELECT '' AS `54`, d1 - timestamp '1997-01-02' AS diff
READ	SELECT '' AS date_trunc_week, date_trunc( 'week', timestamp '2004-02-29 15:44:17.71393' ) AS week_trunc
READ	SELECT '' AS `54`, d1 - timestamp '1997-01-02' AS diff

READ	SELECT make_timestamp(2014,12,28,6,30,45.887)
